basis: AXT’s May 1 release verifies that Q1 2025 consolidated GAAP revenue fell 14.69% to $19,356,000 from $22,688,000, below the $21,553,600 threshold. February 20 remains a plausible earlier disclosure. A third-party transcript attributes an explicit $18 million–$20 million Q1 forecast to CFO Gary Fischer. I located the webcast linked by AXT but could not verify the amount from its recording, an issuer transcript, a filed exhibit, or an issuer deck. The earliest date therefore remains unresolved.

coverage.detail: October 31, 2024, preceding earnings cycle. The Q3 release expressed optimism about growth in 2025 and gave no numeric Q1 2025 revenue ceiling.

AXT’s October 31 call archive led to this webcast. I could not retrieve the recording. The prior review traced the $23 million–$25 million outlook to Q4 2024, the December quarter. [AXT event page](https://investors.axt.com/Investors/events-and-presentations/event-details/2024/AXT-Inc-Third-Quarter-2024-Earnings-Call/default.aspx) and [third-party transcript](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/axti/transcripts/218068-q3-2024/).

AXT’s January 7 announcement scheduled its January 14 presentation for 2:15 p.m. ET. Needham’s own announcement confirms the conference dates. Neither announcement supplies AXT’s presentation remarks. [Needham announcement](https://www.needhamco.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/2025-01-13-Needham-and-Company-to-Host-27th-Annual-Growth-Conference-1.pdf).

The event host identified AXT and the January 14 presentation time, then required registration. I could not verify the January recording or full January deck. The third-party transcript records Fischer referring to guidance already given for Q4. [Conference transcript](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/axti/transcripts/305092-27th-annual-needham-growth-conference/).

The February 20 release reported Q4 and FY2024 results, announced the same-day call, and listed a telephone replay through March 6. It omitted the Q1 revenue range. The filing index identifies the earnings release as Exhibit 99.1 and lists no call transcript or guidance deck. [8-K exhibit index](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1051627/000155837025001218/0001558370-25-001218-index.htm).
AXT’s event page identifies the February 20 Q4 2024 call at 4:30 p.m. ET and links directly to the webcast. The page gives no Q1 guidance figure or transcript.

AXT’s webcast link resolved to a JavaScript-required player. The accessible page exposed no audio or transcript, and a separate direct fetch could not resolve the host. The spoken upper bound remains unverified from the primary source.

The secondary transcript attributes an $18 million–$20 million Q1 revenue range to Fischer and explicitly discusses both substrates and raw materials. Its reported high end would qualify. The separate $4 million–$5 million figure concerns delayed sales only.
AXT’s 12-page March 24 corporate deck was accessible. Page 9 shows annual revenue for FY2019–FY2024, ending at $99.36 million. The deck supplies no Q1 2025 consolidated revenue ceiling.

The April 3 issuer notice scheduled the May 1 release and gave no preliminary revenue. Searches of issuer releases and SEC materials between February 20 and May 1 located no written preliminary result or updated consolidated Q1 range.

The May 1 release’s condensed consolidated statements of operations show revenue of 19,356 and 22,688, in thousands of dollars, for the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024. The same GAAP row supplies both sides of the comparison. The later [Form 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1051627/000155837025007751/axti-20250331x10q.htm) corroborates the figures.

publication_date_evidence: AXT dates the candidate call February 20, 2025 at 4:30 p.m. ET. Its May 1, 2025 release explicitly says AXT reported the March-quarter results that day. May 1 establishes public disclosure of actuals. The missing primary evidence for the February guidance prevents assigning an earliest publication date.
primary_source_reason: Secondary transcript identified during the frozen scorers post-lock source review. The dated evidence must be verifiable on a primary issuer source.
